address: Piazza Martiri della Libertà, 31, Oleggio, 28047, Italy
bio: Nestled in the heart of Oleggio, beneath the portico that opens onto the charming main square with its historic bell tower, Chef Corrado Lombardo showcases his extensive expertise. The restaurant offers an understated entrance and a warm, inviting dining space, complete with intimate tables and a delightful ambiance. The menu masterfully blends culinary skill with traditional flavours, paying homage to seasonal produce and highlighting the finest ingredients with well-judged seasoning and subtle contrasts of aroma. This is all paired with impeccable yet approachable service, creating a refined and thoroughly enjoyable dining experience.
